# Initialize a board and inspect its public files.
exec weft$exe init --json
json
stdout '"initialized": true'
stdout '"projection_updated": true'
! stderr .+
exists WEFT.md tasks tasks/backlog tasks/todo tasks/doing tasks/done
grep '^# Weft$' WEFT.md

exec weft$exe check --json
json
stdout '"ok": true'
stdout '"task_count": 0'
! stderr .+

exec weft$exe check
stdout 'Weft board OK'
stdout '0 tasks'
